title: 第7章 收双龙入宗师境第8章 醍醐灌顶首徒出师
lines: 杨过一路追赶。
对于这些街头巷尾的小混混往哪里躲，没人比他更有经验和心得。
从进扬州城开始，杨过就注意到在城头的破庙和棚区，聚集有不少流民和乞丐。
这俩小子，销赃分钱也肯定会去那个地方。
所以杨过干脆没有理会分头逃跑的两个臭小子，直接寻着破庙和流民聚集的棚区去了。
寇仲和徐子陵两人混入人群，没一会儿发现后面已经没人跟踪。
默契的到事先约定好的破庙后巷碰头。
徐子陵掂量了一下沉甸甸的钱袋，一脸兴奋道：“仲少，我们这次遇到财神爷了！”
寇仲上前，一把拿过钱袋，直接打开，不由哇叫了一声。
这钱袋里的碎银，足够他们俩兄弟填饱肚子小半年时间。
寇仲掏出不少碎银，揣进自己兜里。
一旁的徐子陵瞪大眼睛看着，不由问道：“仲少，你这是做什么……”
寇仲抬头笑了笑，略显荒唐道：“难道你想我把所有钱都上交给竹花帮啊，肯定是大头我们拿啦，傻瓜！”
徐子陵挠了挠头：“可这样要是被竹花帮的人知道了，我们免不了一顿毒打……”
“嘘！小声点就好，到时候把钱偷偷交给贞嫂帮忙保管，或者直接给贞嫂，相当于预定接下来几个月的包子钱，不就行了！”
“还是仲少你聪明，这个办法可行！”
话音刚落，杨过从巷尾出现，脸上挂着笑意：“钱都还没捂热乎，就已经想着怎么花了？”
寇仲和徐子陵看到寻上来的杨过，就像是见了鬼似的。
“陵少，是不是你刚才跑慢了没把人引开，才让人追到这里？”
“胡说，我分明看清楚了的。是你没留意尾巴，把人引过来的吧！”
不等杨过出手，两人自己就先陷入了争执。
杨过看的一阵好笑，觉得两人有点“大难临头各自飞”的感觉。
可就在这时，寇仲抬脚一踢。
地上的一块石头朝着杨过激射而来，徐子陵从衣兜里掏出一把石灰粉，哗的撒开，巷子内顿时烟雾缭绕，看不清路。
“该死！被这两人给唬了！”
杨过气的咬牙切齿，这俩人刚才的争吵，是转移他注意力的做法。
一时不察，居然让他们溜掉！
杨过用衣袖捂住口鼻，随后闭眼直接朝“烟雾”里冲去。
只是没冲多久，突然被面前的重物撞击而停下脚步。
放下手臂一看，自己和两个小毛贼撞了个满怀。
“让我逮住了吧！”杨过立刻捏住二人肩头，不给他们逃走的机会。
寇仲和徐子陵无奈地笑了笑，他们现在还往哪里跑。
content_en:
Yang Guo chased him all the way.
No one has more experience and knowledge about where these street gangsters hide than he does.
From the moment he entered Yangzhou City, Yang Guo noticed that there were many refugees and beggars gathering in the ruined temples and shantytowns at the head of the city.
These two boys would definitely go to that place to sell stolen goods and split the money.
So Yang Guo simply ignored the two brats who ran away separately, and went straight to the ruined temple and the shantytown where the refugees gathered.
Kou Zhong and Xu Ziling blended into the crowd and soon realized that no one was following them.
They tacitly agreed to meet in the alley behind the ruined temple that had been agreed upon in advance.
Xu Ziling weighed the heavy money bag and said excitedly: "Young Master Zhong, we met the God of Wealth this time!"
Kou Zhong stepped forward, took the money bag, opened it directly, and couldn't help but screamed.
The scraps of silver in this purse were enough for the two brothers to fill their stomachs for half a year.
Kou Zhong took out a lot of broken silver and put it into his pocket.
Xu Ziling on the side looked at it with wide eyes and couldn't help but ask: "Young Master Zhong, what are you doing..."
Kou Zhong raised his head and smiled, and said slightly absurdly: "Do you want me to hand over all the money to the Zhuhua Gang? We must have taken the bulk of it, fool!"
Xu Ziling scratched his head: "But if the people from the Zhuhua Gang find out about this, we will inevitably be beaten..."
"Shh! Just keep your voice down, and then secretly give the money to Sister-in-law Zhen for safekeeping, or give it directly to Sister-in-law Zhen, which is equivalent to the money for booking buns for the next few months, okay!"
"Master Zhong, you are smart. This method is feasible!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Yang Guo appeared from the end of the alley with a smile on his face: "You haven't even warmed up your money yet, and you're already thinking about how to spend it?"
When Kou Zhong and Xu Ziling saw Yang Guo coming up, they seemed to have seen a ghost.
"Master Ling, was it because you were running too slow just now and didn't lead people away, so they chased you here?"
"Nonsense, I saw it clearly. You didn't pay attention to the tail and lured the person here!"
Before Yang Guo could take action, the two themselves got into a dispute.
Yang Guo was amused for a while and felt that the two of them had a feeling of "flying separately when disaster strikes".
But at this moment, Kou Zhong raised his foot and kicked him.
A stone on the ground shot toward Yang Guo. Xu Ziling took out a handful of lime powder from his pocket and scattered it. Suddenly, the alley was filled with smoke, making it difficult to see the road.
"Damn it! I was fooled by these two people!"
Yang Guo gritted his teeth angrily. The quarrel between the two people just now was a way to divert his attention.
I accidentally let them slip away!
Yang Guo covered his mouth and nose with his sleeves, then closed his eyes and rushed directly into the "smoke".
But he didn't rush for long when he was suddenly hit by a heavy object in front of him and stopped.
He lowered his arms and saw that he was bumping into two little thieves.
"Let me catch you!" Yang Guo immediately pinched their shoulders, not giving them a chance to escape.
Kou Zhong and Xu Ziling smiled helplessly, wondering where they were going now.
